findings: new_project (scaffold.py:75) does not accept description or contact parameters, and calls init_project with only (path, name). This breaks metadata plumbing for the greenfield+blueprint path. The work order requires explicit arguments at scaffold and onboard entry points. new_project is a public entry point used by the CLI (cli.py), so projects created via blueprint cannot receive description or contact for their community files. Fix: add description=None, contact=None to new_project signature and forward them to init_project(path, name, description=description, contact=contact).

issue_config.yml template contains {{REPO_PLACEHOLDER}} which the renderer replaces with literal 'owner/repo', producing a non-functional GitHub URL (community.py:49). While this satisfies 'no double brace tokens', it leaves placeholder text in rendered output. The spec limits renderer inputs to (name, description, contact) and only requires blank issues be disabled, not functional contact links. Consider either: removing contact_links section entirely when repo info is unavailable, or accepting this as a known limitation since repo URL was not included in the metadata contract.
